nodes.statement:
Assume Assumptions~1, 2 and 3 hold. 
    Consider the two-set policy (alg:two-set) such that $(\eta, \epsilon_N^{\text{fe}})$ is feasibility-ensuring, $\eta=\Theta(1)$ and $\epsilon_N^{\text{fe}}=O(1/N)$. 
    For any $t\geq0$, we have
    \begin{align}
        
        \mathbb{E}\big[m(D^{\textup{OL}}_t\backslash D^{\textup{OL}}_{t+1}) \,\big|\, \Sigma_t\big] &= O(m(D^{\textup{OL}}_t)\exp(-C N m(D^{\textup{OL}}_t)^2)) \quad a.s. \\
        
        \mathbb{P}\big[m(D^{\textup{OL}}_{t}\backslash D^{\textup{OL}}_{t+1}) > 0 \,\big|\, \Sigma_t\big] &= O(\exp(-C N m(D^{\textup{OL}}_t)^2)) \quad a.s.,
    \end{align}
    where $C$ is a positive constant.

nodes.name: Lemma 11
nodes.statement:
Assume Assumptions~1, 2 and 3 hold. 
    Consider the two-set policy (alg:two-set) such that $(\eta, \epsilon_N^{\text{fe}})$ is feasibility-ensuring, $\eta=\Theta(1)$ and $\epsilon_N^{\text{fe}}=O(1/N)$. 
    For any $t\geq0$, we have
    \begin{align}
        
        1-m(D^{\textup{OL}}_t) &\leq  \frac{\lambda_U^{1/2}}{\eta\beta}  h_W(X_t, D^{{{\bar{\pi}}^*}}_t) + \frac{1}{\beta N} + \frac{\epsilon_N^{\text{rd}}+\epsilon_N^{\text{fe}}}{\min(\eta, 1)\beta} \quad a.s.\\
        
        m(D^{\textup{OL}}_t) &= 1 \quad \text{ if } h_U(X_t, [N]) \leq \eta. 
    \end{align}
